A company decided to take its employees on a tour to explore an ancient site. The employees were divided into 3 groups of 200 employees. Each group was assigned 7 tour guides. How many is the total number of people going on this tour?

End your reply with a line of the form 'Final answer: N', where N is the final number.

There are 3 groups of 200 employees, so there are:

3 × 200 = 600 employees

There are also 7 guides per group:

3 × 7 = 21 guides

Total people = 600 + 21 = 621

Final answer: 621
